name: Ayaui Kanojo
source:
This is an adventure game visual novel about the virgin, pure-hearted, kind girlfriend of the protagonist who receives sexual pleasure from another man, and even becomes that man's plaything.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE013844.html]DLsite English[/url]]
